namespace PubDV12

def nextDelay (cur cap : Nat) : Nat := Nat.min (2 * cur) cap

theorem capped_backoff_le_max (cur cap : Nat) : nextDelay cur cap ≤ cap := by

  simp only [Nat.min_def]
